evidence_slice: Bradford Council's adopted Shipley and Canal Road Corridor Area Action Plan was adopted on 12 December 2017 and forms part of the statutory Development Plan. The authority-hosted Open_Data/SCRC_AAP MapServer layer 1 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer whose renderer includes AAP_POLICY SCRC/CCF1 with NAME CCF2 as a Shipley Canal Road Corridor Site Allocation. The adopted/publication evidence identifies CCF2 as Bolton Road, 0.31 hectares, with an indicative capacity of about 16 dwellings at medium/high density.
